Font subsetter: pure-Nim sfnt subset for PDF embedding.

Covers TrueType (glyf) and CFF (CFF `) outlines; CFF2 is rejected (needs a Type2 downgrader). Fonts with no outlines at all (e.g. CBDT bitmap emoji) get a synthesized empty `glyf so cmap/hmtx stay correct: text extracts and measures, color bitmaps are dropped. Layout (GSUB/GPOS/GDEF/etc), variation (fvar/gvar/avar/ HVAR/VVAR/MVAR/STAT), color (COLR/CPAL/CBDT/CBLC/ sbix/SVG `), legacy `kern, and device-metric tables are dropped: PDF shows pre-shaped glyphs via /CIDToGIDMap, so no layout is needed at render time. This is implicitly "pinned to default" (base outlines/advances, no deltas).

Retention is unicode-driven with full closure: GSUB substitutions whose inputs are kept (single/multiple/alternate/ligature/reverse, plus conservative one-level contextual outputs) and composite components are pulled in to fixpoint, so every glyph that shaping the full font can produce survives the subset.

Output is a single sfnt (never TTC) with rebuilt cmap (format 4 + 12), glyf/loca or CFF `, `hmtx (vmtx), maxp, hhea (vhea), head, and a post format 3 when the source carried glyph names. Everything else safe (name, OS/2, gasp, ...) is carried verbatim. Directory is sorted, 4-byte aligned, checksummed.

SubsetError = object of CatchableError
Subsetting failure. 
SubsetOpts = object
  downgradeCff2*: bool       ## Reject CFF2 input with a clear error.
Subset generation options. downgradeCff2 mirrors hb-subset's flag: CFF2 input is rejected with a clear error either way (no Type2 downgrader yet); the flag only controls the message path.
